messages:
Maya Chen: Morning team — quick async check-in for docs/devex (SDK quickstarts, sample apps, doc fixes).

Maya Chen: What I did yesterday: updated Python SDK quickstart for 3.11, added note about connection timeouts, and fixed two typoed headings in the sample-app README.

Maya Chen: Blockers: need one more reviewer on docs PR and CI for the sample-app is still flaky on one pipeline.

Jonathan Rivera: Saw the quickstart changes — LGTM overall, left a tiny nit on wording in the authentication section. Will open a suggestion on the PR.

Jonathan Rivera: I can review the docs PR in ~2 hours, ping me if you need it sooner. :thumbsup:

Eli Park: Blocker on sample app: CI failing on linux-musl job. Repro locally with the musl docker image.

Eli Park: Error excerpt:
```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for cryptography, which is required to install pyproject.toml
  Building wheel for cffi (pyproject.toml) ... error
  OSError: [Errno 36] File name too long
```

ci-bot: CI update — sample-app:linux-musl failed on commit ef3a9c7 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/actions/runs/456789012) — job id #1123

Sam O'Neill: @Eli Park can you try `pip install -U pip setuptools wheel` in the build step? Manymusl builds sometimes choke on older pip/wheel.

Sam O'Neill: Also we might need to pin `cryptography` to the binary wheel for musl or switch to manylinux build container for that job.

Eli Park: Tried bumping pip — still failing. I think it's an ephemeral path length problem in our CI container (long tempdir + build artifacts). Trying to shorten cache paths now.

Maya Chen: If it's a CI infra path thing, can someone nudge infra / infra-oncall? This is blocking the sample app release notes.

Jonathan Rivera: @Maya Chen I can take a quick look at the CI config tonight and try a local musl run. If it's path length we'll try setting `TMPDIR=/tmp/short` for the job.

Eli Park: Good call — setting TMPDIR fixed the local repro. Pushing a CI change now.

ci-bot: CI update — sample-app:linux-musl re-run queued (job #1124)

Maya Chen: Awesome — thanks Eli and Jonathan. No blockers for me after that.

Maya Chen: Today I'll:
- land the docs PR once Jonathan gives a quick thumbs
- add a short note in sample-app README about musl caveat and TMPDIR workaround
- follow up on the quickstart auth nit

Jonathan Rivera: I reviewed the docs PR and left a couple tiny suggestions -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 :eyes:

Sam O'Neill: If CI passes, I'll cut the sample-app patch release and update the quickstart snippets in the docs site.

Maya Chen: Thanks — ping me for final signoff on the release notes. :rocket:

Eli Park: CI passed on re-run (job #1124). I'll merge the small CI fix and open a follow-up to make TMPDIR explicit in the musl job.

Maya Chen: Great wrap. If anyone finds follow-up doc typos, drop them here or open a quick PR. Otherwise we'll do a short sync tomorrow if anything still outstanding.

Jonathan Rivera: Sounds good. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Deploy bot: no deploys triggered by these merges.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — end of check-in.
